propositions: Packaged CLI overview help (overview.txt) and ticket-model.md documentation claim unlink accepts no relation argument, contradicting the current optional relation parameter shipped in commit 73abb5805f.

The unlink operation documentation must document the optional relation argument, the most-recent fallback when relation is omitted, and that explicit relation removal preserves other active relations on the pair.
Event schema documentation must distinguish between optional operation selection (the relation parameter) and the emitted link-UUID targeted UNLINK cancellation event.

The relation-scoped unlink feature shipped with subcommand help, user guide, and CLI reference updates but omitted independently maintained overview.txt and ticket-model.md, creating a deterministic live help contradiction.
